camera.start: locked medium-wide: the human upright behind a hip-high box, hands on its lid, Codex and Clawd small either side, a hairline of blue light at the lid seam
camera.end: the full field: the trio small at the bottom centre, the gadget towering above with its dial as the one emitter, pieces filling the frame
camera.move: widen (pull back and up, no cut)
camera.ledBy: the bubble swelling out of the box (f150-180), then the first stalk's curl projecting up and right (f180-210)

emitter.end: the gadget's dial, high above the trio

figure.note: Face-derived (scripts/s01_layout_measure.py): the sheet's green face is 47 px (panel 1) and 20 px (panel 2) of a 472 px panel, times the model sheet's figure-over-face ratio 7.84. The ratio of the two (0.426) is the widen's zoom and is the number the camera uses. The absolute 78 % over-reads: the sheet draws the human bent over the box with a head larger than the model's 1/8, so an upright figure of that face size would stand below the sheet's own floor line. The render stands the human at 48.6 % of frame height (350 px, feet hidden behind the box); that choice, not the 78 %, is what C25 is measured against (see `staging`).

cameraPose.note: Run 2 (owner default recorded in plans/animation-scaffold-2026-10-14.md, Tier 5 'Owner calls from the run'): the widen ends at zoom 0.6, not 0.425, so the human stays about 210 px tall (350 x 0.6) and the face stays readable; pieces leave the frame instead of fitting it. y 103 keeps the trio's feet (stage y 650) at 688 px of the 720 px frame, as the 0.425 pose did (703 px bottom edge); the dial (699, -124) lands at (697, 224) of the frame and the funnel mouth just inside the top edge. Panel 2 of the sheet still draws the 0.425 framing; the numbers here supersede it.

staging.note: Stage pixels at 1280x720, camera at rest (frame 0). Read from panel 1 of the sheet; the human's height is a choice, see figure.note. Proposed as a blocking diff for arrival.json (the blocking files are another worker's).
staging.funnelFromDial: dial + (104 s, -126 s) at gadget scale s (Gadget.tsx: dial (88,170), funnel mouth (192,44), viewBox origin -20)
